“这狼狗，好像还不错！”

李青山打量着缩回狗窝的狼狗，脸上升起一个新的念头，如今自己也上山两趟了，是时候选一批猎犬跟在身边了。

要是没有猎犬的话，日后就算买了猎枪。

自己，大壮，二壮，赵红旗也不过四个人，若是遇到了野猪群，袍子群很难完成围杀，最多也就留下几只。

但要是有了一群猎犬就不一样了。

打围子的时候，若是训练的好了，可以让这些猎犬驱赶野物，毕竟在老林子里面人的动作一定没有猎犬快，头狗会带领叫仗狗迅速定位，后面还会跟着一部分帮仗狗，可能是不同地方的狩猎习惯搞出来的不同叫法，但意思都差不多。

头狗定位猎物后，带领叫仗狗赶到位置，呈现三面包围的形状，朝着猎物狂吠，将猎物朝着其中一个方向赶去，就像是一个口袋一样，而在口袋的位置，则是埋伏好了猎人。

一旦猎物冲过来，手中猎枪喷射出炙热子弹，将猎物留下。

一些跑乱的猎物，会被帮仗狗扑倒拿下，就算是逃走的猎物，头狗也可以根据地上留下来的踪迹，带领叫仗狗和帮仗狗迅速追上去，争取不让一只猎物成为漏网之鱼。

要是没有猎狗帮忙的话，打围子的话可就累了。

其实这两次打猎，都是李青山自己一个人在山上打，大壮等人充作的是苦力的行当，帮忙扛着猎物，生火，守夜，干一些杂七杂八的杂活。

眼前这只狼狗，也叫狼青犬明显是公的，体型很大，体重至少能到一百二十斤，说明平日里喂养的极为不错，前胸很宽，代表跑起来稳当速度快耐力足，耳朵尖竖说明听觉敏锐，黑色鼻子上的褶皱很多，这代表嗅觉出彩，一条猎狗的嗅觉是尤为重要的，双瞳之中有些棕黑，三角眼，无一不在说明，眼前这条狼青犬是一条好的猎犬。

可惜，这条狼青已经成年了。

最好的猎犬，要从三个月到六个月之间开始培养，三个多月最佳。

“嘭嘭嘭！”

李青山扣动红色大门上的铜质门鼻子，发出一道道沉闷回响，没多久，一名中年男人的声音便在里面传了出来。

“谁啊？”

“别人介绍来的。”

“谁介绍的？”声音逐渐靠近了些。

“梦倩！”

“吱吱吱……！”

李青山话音落下，眼前沉重红色木门发出一道轴承常年没上油的吱嘎声，一名中年圆脸的肥硕胖子便出现在李青山面前，脸上挂着一副慈祥的微笑。

这年头，能吃成这个样子的，可是不多见。

明年虽然是公社化开始，但李青山相信，对于这种善于钻研的人来说，不会有什么太大的影响。

“你来找我，有什么事情吗？”

“后生？”

佛手穿着一身不常见的黄色宽大衣裳，上下打量着李青山微笑道。

“这个，收吗？”

李青山没有废话，掏出口袋内的小玻璃瓶，便给眼前的佛手递了过去。

佛手在见到李青山玻璃瓶内的东西后微微一怔，明显也是见过好东西的，对于李青山玻璃瓶内的东西，也是熟悉，伸手接过来后打开瓶塞，另外一只手朝着自己鼻子的方向挥了挥。

“好东西！”

“里面请！”

佛手说罢，拿着玻璃瓶便率先朝着房间内走了进去，李青山则是紧随其后，刚刚进门，站在门后一侧的一名三十来岁男人，便将大门关上，眼神狠辣，浑身肌肉紧实，皮肤粗犷，不修边幅，还是个三角眼，一看就不是个好惹的。

一只手一直放在上衣口袋里面，这口袋估计是破了洞的，一只手可以直接从口袋的位置掏出插在腰上匕首，当然这个动作不简单，要是一些新手或者脑子愚钝的，说不定会老半天掏不出来。

这个家伙，刚刚一直在后面等着呢。

佛手这家伙就是个走边的，要是被按了脑袋，直接就送去枪毙了，小心点倒也正常，心狠手辣一些，也很正常，否则不要说等着公安来按头了，估计早就被黑吃黑了。

李青山可不认为这货笑嘻嘻的，是什么好人。

房间内。

一股檀香的味道弥漫，想必是焚了香的，家具都是用的老东西，看起来很低调，但是在明眼人看来，却又不是那么低调了。

佛手将李青山的玻璃瓶放在桌子上后，便找了一个十六两杆秤，上面垫了一张极薄的纸，再将麝香放在上面称重，刚刚关门的那家伙没有进来，而是一名二十五六岁的女人走了出来，穿着一身白色衬衫，竟然还涂抹了些许妆容，大红的嘴唇，在这个年代真的不多见。

手中还端着两杯水，其中一杯放在李青山面前，旋即上下打量了李青山一眼道：“啧啧啧，这小兄弟，长得还真俊呢，有对象没？”

“姑娘有对象没？”李青山看了一眼低头秤麝香的佛手，旋即看向女人道。

“没呢。”

“小兄弟，要不要考虑一下？”

金莲伸手朝着李青山摸了过来，纤细的手指一看就是保养过的，白净柔润，落在身上时轻柔，身上有股香水和檀香混杂的味道。

“我可不会负责，姑娘考虑清楚！”李青山上下打量了一眼金莲道。

白送上门的，不要白不要。

“咯咯，小兄弟，有你这句话，姐姐我可就放心了。”金莲语气中夹杂着几分娇媚道。

“小兄弟，一共十五克，新鲜麝香现在市场上的价格是七块七一克，一共是一百一十五块五，如何？”

佛手望着眼前的李青山，开口道。

一百一十五块钱？

七块七一克？

李青山听到佛手的报价后，心中也是一惊，自己的心里价格也就四五块钱一克最多了，没想到能够报价到七块七一克，这已经远远超出了自己的心理价位。

不动声色，语气平淡道：“这项生意，我们可以长期合作！”

“长期合作？”

佛手脸上流露出一抹疑问，旋即慈祥微笑道：“小兄弟，狩猎有很多的不确定性，今天运气好狩猎到一只香獐子，但是下次，可能就不会有这么好的运气了，小兄弟所说的合作，得让我等到猴年马月呀？”

“我能饲养香獐子，并且活取麝香，已经成功！”李青山语气认真道。

“这……！”

“小兄弟，可当真？”

佛手慈祥的脸上闪过一抹惊诧之色，再次上下打量了李青山一眼道。

“当真！”

“这些麝香，就是我活取出来的。”

李青山点头道。

“既如此，长期合作，那这利润，我自然也要让一些出来的，刚刚和小兄弟说的七块七，不作数了，九块钱一克，如何？”

“这已经很多了哦。”

“要不是如今特殊时期，是不可能收这么贵的。”

佛手语气真诚道。

“成交，拿钱吧！”李青山点头道。

九块钱一克，李青山已经满足了，要是卖给收购站，也就是一块三毛五，黄金现在三四块一克，麝香是黄金的两三倍，倒也是正常价格，况且这是新鲜的，要是干麝香自然更贵一些。

当然了，这其中的利润，自然还是有的。

但是，佛手的利润，也是冒着吃枪子的风险带来的，就说这房间内的三个人，一个个都不是简单人。

“一百三十五块钱，小兄弟名号啊？”佛手将钱交给李青山道。

“石溪村，李青山！”

“对了，现在香獐子就一只，但是我饲养的香獐子数量，肯定会越来越多。”

李青山将钱接了过来。

"This wolfdog seems pretty good!"

Li Qingshan looked at the wolfdog that had retreated into the kennel, and a new thought came to his face. Now that he had gone up the mountain twice, it was time to choose a group of hounds to follow him.

If I don’t have a hunting dog, I’ll buy a shotgun in the future.

He, Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang, and Zhao Hongqi are only four people. If they encounter a herd of wild boars, it will be difficult for the Paozi group to complete the siege and they will only leave a few at most.

But it's different if you have a pack of hounds.

When making a fence, if the training is good, these hounds can be used to drive away wild animals. After all, people in the old forest must not move as fast as hounds. The leading dog will lead the barking dogs to quickly locate, followed by some helping dogs. The names may be different due to the hunting habits of different places, but the meanings are the same.

After the lead dog locates the prey, it leads the barking dogs to the position, forming a shape surrounded by three sides. It barks at the prey and drives the prey in one direction, just like a pocket, and in the pocket, the hunter is ambushed.

Once the prey rushes over, the shotgun in his hand sprays hot bullets, leaving the prey behind.

Some stray prey will be knocked down by the guard dogs. Even if the prey escapes, the lead dog can lead the barking dogs and help dogs to catch up quickly based on the traces left on the ground, trying to prevent a prey from slipping through the net.

Without the help of hunting dogs, it would be tiring to make the fence.

In fact, during these two hunts, Li Qingshan hunted alone in the mountains. Da Zhuang and others acted as coolies, helping to carry the prey, light fires, keep watch, and do other miscellaneous chores.

The wolf dog in front of me, also called Wolf Green Dog, is obviously a male. It is very large and weighs at least 120 kilograms, which means that it has been well fed in daily life. The front chest is very wide, which means it can run steadily, fast and has sufficient endurance. The pointed ears indicate keen hearing, and there are many wrinkles on the black nose, which means that the sense of smell is excellent. The smell of a hunting dog is particularly important. The eyes are brown and black, and the triangular eyes all indicate that the Wolf Blue Dog in front of you is a good hunting dog.

Unfortunately, this wolf has grown up.

The best hunting dogs should be trained from three months to six months, with more than three months being the best.

"Bang bang bang!"

Li Qingshan clicked the copper door nose on the red door, and there were dull echoes. Not long after, a middle-aged man's voice came from inside.

"Who?"

"I was introduced by someone else."

"Who introduced you?" The voice gradually got closer.

"Mengqian!"

"Squeak, squeak, squeak...!"

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, the heavy red wooden door in front of him made a creaking sound as the bearings had not been oiled for many years. A middle-aged fat man with a round face appeared in front of Li Qingshan with a kind smile on his face.

These days, it’s rare to see people eat like this.

Although communeization will begin next year, Li Qingshan believes that it will not have much impact on such people who are good at studying.

"You came to me, what's the matter?"

"Afterlife?"

Buddha's Hand was wearing an unusual yellow baggy dress. He looked up and down at Li Qingshan and said with a smile.

"Do you want to take this?"

Li Qingshan didn't waste any time. He took out the small glass bottle from his pocket and handed it to the Buddha's hand in front of him.

Buddha's Hand was slightly startled after seeing the contents of Li Qingshan's glass bottle. He had obviously seen good things before, and was familiar with the contents of Li Qingshan's glass bottle. He reached out to take it and uncorked the bottle, and waved his other hand in the direction of his nose.

"Good stuff!"

"Inside please!"

After that, Buddha Hand took the lead and walked into the room with the glass bottle, followed closely by Li Qingshan. As soon as he entered the door, a man in his thirties standing on the side behind the door closed the door. He had fierce eyes, tight muscles, rough skin, slovenly appearance, and triangular eyes. He was not easy to mess with at first glance.

One hand is always placed in the pocket of the coat. This pocket is probably torn. With one hand, one can directly take out the dagger stuck on the waist from the pocket. Of course, this action is not simple. If some novices or stupid people, they may not be able to take it out for a long time.

This guy has been waiting behind him just now.

Buddha's Hand is just a walk-in. If he is pressed on the head, he will be shot directly. It is normal to be careful. It is also normal to be ruthless. Otherwise, don't wait for the police to come and press his head. He would have been hacked long ago.

Li Qingshan didn't think that this smiling guy was a good person.

inside the room.

There is a smell of sandalwood, which must have been burned. The furniture is made of old things, which looks very low-key, but to a discerning eye, it is not so low-key.

After Buddha placed Li Qingshan's glass bottle on the table, he found a sixteen-liang steelyard, put a very thin piece of paper on it, and put the musk on it to weigh it. The guy who just closed the door did not come in, but a woman in her mid-twenties came out. She was wearing a white shirt and even applied some makeup. She had bright red lips, which is really rare in this era.

There were two glasses of water in his hand, one of which was placed in front of Li Qingshan. He immediately looked Li Qingshan up and down and said, "Tsk, tsk, tsk, this little brother is really handsome. Do you have anyone?"

"Does the girl have a partner?" Li Qingshan glanced at the Buddha's hand that was lowering its head to weigh the musk, and then looked at the woman and asked.

"Nothing."

"Little brother, do you want to think about it?"

Jin Lian stretched out her hand and touched Li Qingshan. Her slender fingers looked like they had been cared for. They were white and soft. They fell gently on her body, and her body smelled of perfume and sandalwood.

"I will not be responsible, girl, think carefully!" Li Qingshan looked Jin Lian up and down and said.

It's free, don't ask for it.

"Gee, little brother, with your words, I can rest assured, sister." Jin Lian said with a hint of coquettishness in her tone.

"Little brother, there are fifteen grams in total. The current price of fresh musk on the market is seven yuan and seventy-one grams. The total is one hundred and fifteen yuan. How about it?"

Buddha's Hand looked at Li Qingshan in front of him and said.

One hundred and fifteen dollars?

Seven yuan and seventy-one grams?

Li Qingshan was shocked when he heard the price quoted for Buddha's Hand. He thought the price was only four or five yuan per gram, but he didn't expect the price to be quoted at seven yuan and seventy-one grams. This was far beyond his psychological price.

He remained calm and said in a calm tone: "We can cooperate in this business for a long time!"

"Long-term cooperation?"

There was a trace of doubt on Buddha's hand's face, and then he said with a kind smile: "Little brother, there are many uncertainties in hunting. I was lucky enough to hunt a fragrant deer today, but next time, I may not have such good luck. The cooperation that little brother said requires me to wait until the Year of the Monkey and the Horse."

"I can raise fragrant deer and harvest musk alive. I have succeeded!" Li Qingshan said in a serious tone.

"This...!"

"Little brother, are you serious?"

A look of surprise flashed across Buddha's hand's kind face, and he looked Li Qingshan up and down again.

"Seriously!"

"These musks are what I bring to life."

Li Qingshan nodded.

"In this case, if we cooperate for a long time, I will naturally let some of the profits come out. The seven yuan and seven that I just talked about with my little brother don't count. How about nine yuan per gram?"

"This is already a lot."

"If it weren't for this special period, it would be impossible to charge so much."

Buddha's hand said in a sincere tone.

"Deal, take the money!" Li Qingshan nodded.

Li Qingshan was satisfied with nine yuan per gram. If sold to the buying station, it would be one yuan and thirty-five cents. Gold is now three to four yuan per gram. Musk is two or three times the price of gold, which is the normal price. Besides, it is fresh. Dry musk is naturally more expensive.

Of course, there is still profit in this.

However, the profit of Buddha's Hand is also brought about by taking the risk of taking a bullet. Let's just say that the three people in this room are not simple people.

"One hundred and thirty-five yuan, what's your little brother's name?" Buddha's hand handed the money to Li Qingshan and said.

"Shixi Village, Li Qingshan!"

"By the way, there is only one fragrant deer now, but the number of fragrant deer I raise will definitely increase."

Li Qingshan took the money.
